reviews.summary: "get let slip" is broken grammar and trips the reader.; A note doesn't "say" a question. It asks it.; "presionada" makes the partner female. The English is neutral ("they"), and VOICE says the reader is most often proposing to him.; In Spain you "pedir" a proposal, you don't "preguntar" it. "Pregúntalo" reads as a translation of "Ask".; "no aún en la cama" is a calque of "not still in bed". Speakers in Spain say "todavía".
